label: Moving the setup edge
subgoals: Multiply the period by N to get the setup capture edge
Subtract setup and the launch-side delays
Confirm the logic samples the data only every N cycles

label: The default hold check moves too
section: The default hold check moves too
subgoals: Place the default hold check one capture edge before the new setup edge
Compute the hold slack against that edge
Recognize the large negative result as an artifact of the missing hold adjustment

label: Pulling the hold check back
subgoals: Subtract M cycles from the default hold edge
Use M equal to N minus 1 to restore the same-edge hold check
Compute the hold slack against the adjusted edge
